#summary Overview of Producer/Consumer messaging.

= Producer/Consumer Messaging =
 * ChannelSet objects route request messages and dispatch response messages.
 * Each ChannelSet contains a MessageAgent object which handles receiving and publishing AsyncMessages.
 * Each ChannelSet contains one or more [Channel] objects. [Channel]s handle the technical details of sending and receiving messages.

== Simple Wsgi Example ==
{{{
from amfast import remoting

# A ChannelSet uses a MessageAgent
# to publish messages.
channel_set = channel.ChannelSet(service_mapper=service_mapper)

# Each ChannelSet contains one or more Channels
# which handle the actual receiving and sending of messages.
# AmFast includes built-in channels for CherryPy,
# Twisted Web, and WSGI.
wsgi_app = WsgiChannel('rpc-channel')
channel_set.mapChannel(wsgi_app)

# Serve the WSGI channel
server = simple_server((domain, port), simple_server.WSGIRequestHandler)
server.set_app(wsgi_app)
server.serve_forever()

# Publish a message
channel_set.message_agent.publish(message, 'topic', 'sub_topic')
}}}
